guide.geminiTitle: How to get your Gemini API key
guide.step1Go: Go to {link} and sign in with your Google account
guide.geminiStep3: Click {button} and select or create a project
guide.geminiStep4: Copy the generated key and paste it below
guide.geminiNote: Free tier available — no credit card required.
guide.anthropicTitle: How to get your Anthropic API key
guide.anthropicStep1Go: Go to {link} and create an account or sign in
guide.anthropicStep3: Click {button}, give it a name and copy it
guide.anthropicStep4: Add at least {credits} under {billing} to activate API access
guide.anthropicNote: Recommended model: {code} — fast and very cheap (~$0.001 per import).
guide.openaiTitle: How to get your OpenAI API key
guide.openaiStep1Go: Go to {link} and create an account or sign in
guide.openaiStep3: Click {button}, give it a name and copy it
guide.openaiStep4: Add credits under {billing} to activate API access
guide.openaiNote: Recommended model: {code} — best balance of speed and cost.
guide.xaiTitle: How to get your xAI (Grok) API key
guide.xaiStep1Go: Go to {link} and sign in with your X (Twitter) account
guide.xaiStep2: Go to {apiKeys} in the left sidebar
guide.xaiStep3: Click {button}, give it a name and copy it
guide.xaiStep4: Add credits under {billing} to activate API access
guide.xaiNote: Recommended model: {code} — faster and cheaper than Grok-2.
